source_refs.note: Topic 7.6.3.2 with the Cyber Scout class activity (PDF 189, printed 186). The programme's current details are not verified, flagged.

blocks.text: Protect personal information by using privacy settings, for example setting a Facebook profile to private so only friends see posts, and by being careful with public information, never posting your home address or phone number publicly.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: find out how a student can become a Cyber Scout with NR3C-FIA. Why would such a programme help?
blocks.explanation: Trained students can spread cyber-safety awareness among classmates and family and know how to report online crime; check the agency's current website for the programme's details.

items: Protect personal information: privacy settings and no public address or phone number.
